title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Agreement — Regular-Payer Reduction of the Payoff Accrual Rate
content:
**Clause.** On the payoff of a Ridgeline Pro Credit commercial account, the payoff accrual rate — the monthly percentage at which the interim payoff accrual runs on the latest statement's past-due amount — is the tier's monthly late payment charge percentage less the regular-payer reduction, never below zero. The regular-payer reduction rewards a steady payment record and is set by the account's payment lines and guarantee:

| Payment lines credited to the account in the last 12 months | A principal's personal guarantee on file | Regular-payer reduction |
|---|---|---|
| At least 6 | Yes | 0.50 percentage points (guaranteed regular-payer reduction) |
| At least 6 | No | 0.25 percentage points (standard regular-payer reduction) |
| Fewer than 6 | Either | Zero |

## Reading the record

- The 12 months are whole calendar months counted back from the payment date.
- Payment lines are the payment lines credited to the account in that window; one payment applied to several invoices shows as several payment lines.
- Whether a personal guarantee is on file is shown on the account record.

## Cases (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 45 at 1.50 percent)

| Payment lines in 12 months | Guarantee on file | Payoff accrual rate |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | Yes | 1.00 percent |
| 9 | No | 1.25 percent |
| 5 | Yes | 1.50 percent |
